# Creator Flow

日常内容工作从 `skills/self-media-workflow/SKILL.md` 进入，以 README、本文件和相关 Skill 为准。作品目录、默认画幅与封面规格统一由本文件规定，Skill 和工具说明按需引用。按需求读取必要素材和可编辑源，只加载当前决策需要的参考，不递归展开链接。不要默认读取历史会话、全部引擎、账号或旧审核；整改文档仅供追溯，普通修改不再追加整改记录。

## 作品与工具

- `workspace/<作品名>/`：故事线、素材、声音、字幕、可编辑工程、图片、视频和封面，全部忽略 Git。同一作品跨平台复用，不复制整套工程。
- `projects/<作品名>/`：已有独立专题的唯一工程位置，保留原生布局。
- `tools/video/`、`tools/cards/`、`tools/canvas/`：按能力组织的本地制作工具、必要模板、依赖与行为测试。
- `skills/`：轻量总入口、写作、专项制作和按指令发布。外部依赖保留实际调用的组件与许可。
- `docs/`：必要工具和平台操作说明；历史资料不是日常必读。
- `.local/`：安装副本、维护恢复资料及账号/会话；不放唯一作品源码，不入 Git。多个作品确实共用的素材可留 `workspace/_shared/`。

不再新增平台作品树、状态机、审批文件、产物清单、发布台账、打包器或复盘系统。原生工程必需的时间轴、声音对齐、依赖锁文件继续保留。旧 state、审核、成品与发布事实不改写为新结果。

## 制作

写作、选题、标题和发布文案前读 `workspace/_shared/creator/profile.md`（创作者定位、平台账号、说话方式与系列，私有不入 Git），选题想法追加到同目录 `ideas.md`；用户多次确认的稳定偏好写回档案，单次反馈留在作品。从目标与素材推导故事线、画面和声音，再选择能实现它的工具。不设默认风格或默认引擎；新视频无其他要求时横屏 4K，已有作品沿用实际规格。局部请求只改相关部分，复用准确声源和未变素材；不重复审批已明确的选择。

完整视频、图文作品提供独立的 `cover-4x3.png`、`cover-3x4.png`、`cover-9x16.png`：共用标题与主视觉，分别调整构图、文字和安全边距，保留设计源。只写脚本、改字幕等局部请求不扩成完整制作。

直接交付 MP4 或图文图片与必要文案。源文件和原素材留在作品内；不默认生成网页预览、播放器、ZIP、工程包或附属报告。HTML/Canvas 是可编辑动画源，可以保留。

实际检查内容、文字、裁切、画面、动作、规格、全解码及适用的声音/同步。机器核验、看图、连续播放、实际听音、作者确认和发布不得混淆；没做的如实说明，不要求填写审核表或运行批准命令。

## 保护与改进

原素材只读，保留旧成品和已有未提交内容。输出工具拒绝覆盖并在成功后落定；失败保留必要定位资料。修订只带必要源与配置，不复制旧帧序列、bundle、缓存或 ZIP。流式编码不落全量帧。清理仅限核对用途、引用和恢复依据后的明确对象。

从实际问题或反馈改进叙事、布局、声音、复用与渲染效率，检查受影响成品即可。通用方法更新对应 Skill 权威源码，作品特例留作品。外部能力的发现、试用、适配、更新与替换见总入口的 `references/open-source-capabilities.md`；依需求重复执行，不建立后台监控，不自动升级在制作品。

新风格、声音或关键工具先试覆盖难点的代表段；成熟能力直接制作。未听音的新声不扩整批。并行前实测单任务资源与耗时；默认单 Agent。只测试真实制作、输出保护与必要行为，不为规则文本新增治理测试。

## 发布与外部操作

准备发布标题、正文或手动发布素材时，即使不执行上传，也必须合并本次用户要求、以下平台话题和内容相关话题；交付前逐平台核对最终文案中的话题原文，不能只检查技术标签。当前用户指定：抖音带 `#猪猪猪序员 #vibe大赏`；小红书带 `#ai替我说 #ai讲知识`。保留准确写法，不把 `#ai讲知识` 换成历史记录中的 `#用ai讲知识`。这些话题适用于当前发布工作，用户修改或取消时更新此处；不据此声称活动仍有效或已成功参与。实际上传时另核对平台话题实体。

本地制作不授予发布权。收到具体作品、平台、账号和时间的指令后，确认真实文件与文案，复用会话，上传填写，回读关键字段，提交并查后台；同一作品多平台使用同一工程。结果不明先查后台，避免重复提交。直接反馈上传、审核中、定时已保存、后台发布和公开可见的真实结果，不要求台账。平台步骤见 `skills/multi-platform-publish/` 和对应 `docs/*publishing.md`。

不自动提交、推送、付费、连接账号、回复或创建长期调度。若另获提交授权，只精确暂存本轮路径并检查完整暂存 diff；禁止全树 add、重置或清理。用户本轮禁止提交/推送也适用于 Skill 同步，不通过 Hook 扩大授权。

复用 WSL2/Linux 与既有 Windows/UI 会话。项目 PowerShell 可每进程 `RemoteSigned`，不得 `Bypass` 或改全局策略；不干扰其他浏览器、不导出 Cookie。素材须有合法使用依据，简短附在现有内容或素材说明；公开可见不等于可复用。

交叉符号发现先 CodeGraph；不可用时定向 rg，不自动建索引。`.agents`、`.codex` 只读。项目事实不写入用户记忆。

# MCP Server Instructions

The following MCP servers have provided instructions for how to use their tools and resources:

## claude.ai Claude Docs
Claude Docs: living docs you create and edit here. A docs skill your client lists → load it before any docs call — also before a `read`, comment or tab change on a claude.ai …/artifact/… link (the link is a doc; never web-fetch it). No docs skill or guide text loaded → `guide( items = ["topic.index"] )` alone before any docs call but a doc's birth. Make a doc here — not a local file, even when coding — only when the user asks for one, and make it FIRST: the turn's first tool call is its skeleton (title, byline, a `pending` block per section) — a reflex: send it before any search, file read, plan, `guide` or thinking it through; think once it is open — `batch( container = {"kind":"project","create":{"name":"<title>","doc":{"blocks":{"asof":{"type":"date","value":"<today>"},"me":{"type":"mention","user":"me"},"s1":{"type":"pending","intent":"Goals: the three outcomes this quarter commits to"},"s2":{…}},"markdown":"# <title>\n\n<?claude block asof?> · <?claude block me?>\n\n<?claude block s1?>\n\n<?claude block s2?>"}}}, batch = [] )` (`<?claude block k?>` ↔ `blocks.k`); its ack links the doc → `open` it with your Artifact tool (none → start your next message with the link, once); they're likely watching it fill — keep them posted in a short line naming what you're on (outline up; now <topic>); findings go in the doc, not chat; then `guide( items = ["topic.index"] )`, research, and fill each section: `replace` its pending id with `## <heading>` + body; end with one line + the link, never the document. Summoned by a doc comment (turn headed `[Artifact comment sent to Claude]`, `;thread=<root id>`): answer ONLY with a doc comment under that root (`create` an utterance, parent `<root id>`) — no artifact/platform comment tool: that relay thread is resolved and never reaches the doc; an edit asked there → `update` with `answering: "<root id>"`.

The following skills are available for use with the Skill tool:

- academy-guide: Stop and check this skill before finishing any reply to a question about how to use Claude or a Claude product — it recommends matching courses, tutorials, and use cases from Claude Academy (academy.claude.com), Anthropic's learning hub. Trigger on: "how do I", "how can I", "getting started with", "what can Claude do", "teach me", "learn to use"; questions about artifacts, projects, skills, plugins, connectors, MCP; requests about rolling Claude out to a team, class, or organization; and any ask for training materials, onboarding content, or learning resources. Use it when the user is learning how to use a feature or product — not when they are mid-task and just want the task done. This skill composes with other skills: after consulting product documentation to answer how a Claude feature works, also check here for a matching course or tutorial — a docs-grounded answer and an Academy recommendation belong together. Only recommend on a strong match; never invent Academy content.
- algorithmic-art: Creating algorithmic art using p5.js with seeded randomness and interactive parameter exploration. Use this when users request creating art using code, generative art, algorithmic art, flow fields, or particle systems. Create original algorithmic art rather than copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.
- apple-design: Apple's approach to interface design and fluid, physical motion, translated for the web. Use when building or reviewing gesture-driven UI, spring animations, drag/swipe/sheet interactions, momentum and interruptible transitions, translucent materials and depth, typography (optical sizing, tracking, leading), reduced-motion, or the design foundations (feedback, spatial consistency, restraint) behind Apple-style interfaces.
- brand-guidelines: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.
- break-ui: Try to break a piece of UI by feeding it worst-case data — long names, unbreakable emails, one-letter names, missing fields, huge counts, zero items, long labels, non-Latin text, emoji, extreme numbers — then render it behind a "Demo data / Worst case" toggle and report everything that broke, with the fix for each. Use when the user asks to stress-test, break, or find edge cases in a component or screen, or to "try the worst case". For visual design critique use emil-design-eng; for motion use review-animations.
- canvas-design: Create beautiful visual art in .png and .pdf documents using design philosophy. You should use this skill when the user asks to create a poster, piece of art, design, or other static piece. Create original visual designs, never copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.
- captions-overlay: Overlay doctrine for captions in HyperFrames videos — the caption MODEL (drop / rail / embed) and the rule that captions are an OVERLAY composited on top of the film, never a reserved bottom band you shift content up to avoid. Load when adding captions/subtitles to a talking-head or launch video, when deciding whether a phrase should be dropped, ride the verbatim rail, or be promoted to a scarce embedded climax, when laying out a composition that will carry captions (do NOT reserve a keep-out band), or when centering a composition on the true frame center under captions. Applies ON TOP of the `/hyperframes` skill's references/captions.md.
- discernment-nudge: After you give a substantive answer or draft that the user may act on — advice or recommendations, drafted artifacts such as goals, plans, pitches, proposals, or emails, estimates or projections, analysis or interpretation of data, factual claims they may rely on, or a multi-step argument — invoke this skill BEFORE finalizing your reply and then, if it applies, append 2-3 short follow-up questions, each tied to something specific in what you just produced, that help the user check key facts, probe the reasoning or assumptions, and notice missing context. Do this at most once per conversation. Skip it when the user asked a trivial how-to or simple lookup, wants a purely educational explanation, asked you only to format, convert, or assemble a file from content they provided, is writing code they will run, is doing creative writing or casual chat, or already asked you to double-check, cite, or review — the skill file explains these boundaries and the exact output format.
- doc-coauthoring: Guide users through a structured workflow for co-authoring documentation. Use when user wants to write documentation, proposals, technical specs, decision docs, or similar structured content. This workflow helps users efficiently transfer context, refine content through iteration, and verify the doc works for readers. Trigger when user mentions writing docs, creating proposals, drafting specs, or similar documentation tasks.
- docx: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.

- ffmpeg-skill: Edit video and audio with local FFmpeg: cut, join, reframe, speed, captions, overlays, silence removal, sync, loudness, HDR to SDR, platform exports and checks. Use whenever the user mentions a video or audio file (mp4, mov, wav, m4a), footage, captions, a reel or short, YouTube/TikTok delivery, LUFS or ffmpeg, even without saying "edit". Needs FFmpeg 6.1+ and Python 3.10+; stdlib only, no cloud.

Holds the render contract, the work loop and what each kind of video needs.
- hyperframes-cli: The HyperFrames CLI by job - scaffold, check, look at frames, edit the timeline, preview, render locally or in the cloud, publish, project history - plus reading its JSON and recovering from build or render failures.
- impeccable: Use when the user wants to design, redesign, shape, critique, audit, polish, simplify, harden, animate, or otherwise improve a frontend interface: websites, landing pages, dashboards, product UI, components, forms, settings, onboarding, empty states, and native iOS or Android screens. Handles UX review, hierarchy, layout, typography, color, motion, UX copy, accessibility, responsive behavior, edge cases, and capturing or documenting design systems (DESIGN.md, tokens). Also for making bland UI bolder, loud UI quieter, or ambitious visual effects. Not for backend-only or non-UI tasks.
- improve-animations: Survey a codebase's animation and motion code as a senior motion advisor, then produce a prioritized audit and self-contained implementation plans for other agents (or cheaper models) to execute. Read-only on source code — it plans improvements, it does not apply them. Use when the user asks to "improve the animations", "audit the motion", "make this app feel better", or wants a roadmap of animation fixes rather than a review of a single diff.
- internal-comms: A set of resources to help me write all kinds of internal communications, using the formats that my company likes to use. Claude should use this skill whenever asked to write some sort of internal communications (status reports, leadership updates, 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQs, incident reports, project updates, etc.).
- mcp-builder: Guide for creating high-quality MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that enable LLMs to interact with external services through well-designed tools. Use when building MCP servers to integrate external APIs or services, whether in Python (FastMCP) or Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK).
- media-use: Get or make any media for a HyperFrames video - music, sound effects, images, icons, logos, voiceover, avatar and generated video, transcripts, cutouts, colour grades and looks - with HeyGen or free local tools, and mix placed audio. Also for footage that looks dark, flat or dull, or should be stylized or hidden.
- motion-doctrine: GATEWAY — load FIRST before composing any HyperFrames animation or video. The high-level motion law that makes a multi-scene video feel like ONE continuous camera move instead of a stack of independently-animated slides. Covers the vector law (how you exit determines how you enter, incl. the Z scale-sign rule), the film's current, carrier elements, causal motion, the Seam Gate (build-gate enforcement), the ban on idle wobble (motion must PERFORM, not breathe), stillness-before-climax, and the sustained-motion routes. Routes to the low-level technique skills (cut-the-curve — the full catalog incl. waterfall entry + nudge curve, oversized-cursor, seam-craft). These rules SUPERSEDE generic / upstream motion guidance. [continuity, direction, vector, momentum, seam, transition, ease, performance, idle-motion, narrative-motion, film-grammar]
- pdf: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill.
- pptx: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email or summary); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user mentions "deck," "slides," "presentation," or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. If a .pptx or .potx file needs to be opened, created, or touched, use this skill.

- xlsx: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like "the xlsx in my downloads") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. - dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. When the destination is a first-party document connector (host-designated, never self-described) that renders live charts, hand it the rows (inline, or as an uploaded data file the chart cites) rather than a rendered PNG/SVG — a picture of a chart loses hover, data inspection and per-value comments. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. - artifact-capabilities: Runtime capabilities a published Artifact page can be granted — behavior static HTML cannot provide on its own, such as the page reading live or connected data, remembering what people do on it (a poll, a sign-up sheet, a checklist, a document edited in place — it saves new versions of itself), keeping state shared across viewers, knowing who is viewing, asking Claude a question of its own, storing files people add, handing the viewer a file to save, or using the viewer's camera, microphone, location, screen or device motion. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. # Creator Flow

制作自媒体内容，按你的具体指令发布。直接说想做什么、已有素材和期望结果；无需选择 Skill、引擎或填写流程表。

唯一日常入口是 [self-media-workflow](skills/self-media-workflow/SKILL.md)。它按内容选择写作、视频、图文、声音和封面能力；从实际问题持续改进，并按需发现、试用、接入和更新 GitHub 开源能力。

作品目录、默认画幅与完整作品封面规格统一见 [项目规则](AGENTS.md)。局部请求只交付所需内容。

直接检查并交付成品，无需审核记录、批准命令、清单、发布台账、打包或状态推进。发布仍需指定作品、平台、账号和时间。

实际工具：[视频](tools/video/README.md)、[图文与封面](tools/cards/README.md)、[Canvas](tools/canvas/README.md)。维护时按需查看 [组件与开源接入](docs/components.md)、[Skill 归属](docs/skill-library.md)；[整改历史](docs/creator-flow-simplification-plan.md)仅供追溯。

# Self-media workflow

Start with the requested result, available material and actual editable source. Follow applicable project instructions; `AGENTS.md` owns work directories, output specifications/defaults and cover requirements. Recover established choices before asking and continue within existing authorization. A script request ends with the script; a local correction changes only the affected part.

Read only source and reference sections needed for the current decision. Links are optional routes, not a reading queue: do not recursively load tool manuals, dependency documents or upstream Skills, or reread guidance already available.

## Select what this work needs

| Need | Use |
| --- | --- |
| Topic, storyline, script, title or image-post copy | `content-authoring`; its spoken-commentary reference for first-person narration and screen recordings, its technical-explanation reference for mechanisms |
| Polish an existing recording with chapters, diagrams or captions | `talking-head-polish` when available, with the project's overlay/compose command; keep the full speech and original sound |
| Make or revise a video | Relevant sections of [video production](references/video-production.md): inputs, engine, sound, rendering and export checks |
| New narrative or substantial visual redesign | [Narrative animation](references/narrative-animation.md) for story, causal shots and comprehension; `ui-design-lab` video mode when useful |
| Image post or cover | Existing editable HTML/design/image tools; compose at the requested dimensions and export real images |
| Explicitly selected hand-drawn explanation | `technical-handdraw-video` with its available production engine |
| Specific upload, scheduling or publication instruction | `multi-platform-publish` using the actual files and the user's destination/time |
| A production gap or useful improvement opportunity | [Open-source capabilities](references/open-source-capabilities.md) for discovery, trial, integration, updates and replacement |

For a subtitle-only edit, read the affected subtitle/timing source, the selected tool's composition command and [rendering](references/video-production.md#render-the-requested-change)/[export checks](references/video-production.md#verify-the-export). An established-style local edit keeps its direction and engine; open the narrative reference when the story or visual explanation needs substantial redesign.

Preserve original media, previous exports and editable inputs in the project's native layout. Deliver the requested actual outputs under project requirements; report material verification gaps. Extras and archives require a request. Do not add approval packages, workflow forms or stage transitions. If an upstream coordinator adds unrelated gates, use its production layer or another suitable tool; never fabricate approvals.

Promote only methods shown to improve the work into the authoritative Skill and keep supported project copies consistent. Check ownership and existing differences before editing. Work-specific decisions stay with the work; remove superseded guidance when replacing a method instead of accumulating alternatives.

Local delivery never starts publication. For a publishing instruction, confirm the actual work, account, destination and time, then use the publishing capability. An uncertain prior submission requires backend readback before retrying.

# Skill 归属与使用

唯一日常入口是 [self-media-workflow](../skills/self-media-workflow/SKILL.md)。按请求选择写作、图文/封面、原生视频、手绘或发布；不加载全部 Skill，不要求用户选引擎或填状态表。开源发现、试用、接入、更新与替换直接连在入口的 [能力迭代参考](../skills/self-media-workflow/references/open-source-capabilities.md)。

| 项目使用的个人 Skill | catalog 分组 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| self-media-workflow | content | 需求到实际成品，按需选择能力并持续改进 |
| content-authoring | content | 故事线、技术解释、脚本、图文与封面文案 |
| technical-handdraw-video | content | 内容需要时使用逐步描线与准确声音 |
| multi-platform-publish | publishing | 指定文件、平台、账号和时间的 UI 操作与结果回读 |
| ui-design-lab（已有安装入口） | engineering | 视觉关系、文字密度、动作和多比例构图 |

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
lock=json.loads((root/'skills.lock.json').read_text())
count=0
patched_count=0
patch_count=0
for component in lock['components']:
    patched_files={}
    for patch in component.get('local_patches', []):
        path=root/patch['path']
        if not path.is_file() or hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=patch['sha256']:
            raise SystemExit('本地补丁文件不匹配：'+patch['path'])
        for name,expected in patch['files'].items():
            if name not in component['files'] or name in patched_files:
                raise SystemExit('本地补丁目标未固定或重复：'+name)
            patched_files[name]=expected
        patch_count+=1
    for name,expected in component['files'].items():
        path=root/name
        # Keep the upstream hashes intact; only reviewed patch targets use a
        # separate expected hash. The patch itself is pinned above.
        expected=patched_files.get(name, expected)
        if not path.is_file() or hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=expected:
            raise SystemExit('固定版本文件不匹配：'+name)
        count+=1
    patched_count+=len(patched_files)
print(f'已核对 {count} 个固定版本文件（含 {patched_count} 个本地补丁文件），{patch_count} 个补丁')

# 视频调研制作方法总览（沉淀 2026-10）

来源：你 WSL 工程 `~/project/03-media-design/creator-flow`、微信里马丁没有早晨那条抖音参考、以及 box 上的 `vibe-knowledge-film` / `lemo-opuscar` 技能。

---

## 1. 抖音参考：马丁没有早晨「用 Opus 5.5 做出爆款动效」

- 抖音视频号示例：`7700152862696836379`
- **核心不是一句短提示词**，而是：
  1. 走 **HyperFrames / Remotion** 这类代码动画框架（动效 MG），而不是 Higgsfield 一类「一句话出片」
  2. 用 **长结构化提示**：产品 / 故事 / 画幅格式 / 画面气质 / 运动 / 声音 / QC，分块写清楚
  3. 出片后靠抽帧 / contact sheet 做质检，再改再渲

---

## 2. Opus 5.5「效果」真正指什么（工程结论）

公开案例里所谓 Opus 级观感，靠的是可复现流程，不是神秘模型滤镜：

1. **一个贯穿的视觉机制**（一条线、一个物件、一对路径）讲完整件事  
2. **画面是时间的纯函数** `render(t)`，确定性、可单帧重渲  
3. **配乐 / 动作共用同一条时间线**  
4. **全片渲之前先审关键帧 / contact sheet**；成片后再解码抽帧复核  
5. 每个镜头要能看见：**输入 → 规则 → 结果**；旁白动词要落在画面动作上  
6. 禁止：装饰粒子乱爆、弹跳进场、虚构终端结果、没测过的性能数字

@AGENTS.md

## Claude Code 接入

上面的 `AGENTS.md` 是唯一项目规则，本节只说明 Claude Code 怎么接入，不重复也不覆盖规则。

- 日常请求从 `self-media-workflow` Skill 进入。项目 Skill 通过 `.claude/skills/` 下指向 `skills/` 的链接提供，修改时改 `skills/` 里的源码，不在 `.claude/` 内复制。
- 用户级 Skill（如 `hyperframes`、`remotion-*`、`ffmpeg-skill`、`media-use`）是可选能力，按 `self-media-workflow` 的选择表和作品需要加载；项目规则优先于它们的默认画幅、目录、声音和审核步骤。
- `.claude/settings.json` 只放项目共用的权限：提交、推送、暂存全树和读取账号资料前都会询问。个人放宽写到 `.claude/settings.local.json`（不入 Git）。
- 长时间渲染放到后台运行，结束时自动通知，不轮询。并行 Agent 遵守 AGENTS.md 的默认单 Agent 规则。

# Skill 与 Agent 接入

唯一日常入口是 [self-media-workflow](../skills/self-media-workflow/SKILL.md)。它按请求选择写作、图文/封面、视频、手绘或发布；不一次加载全部 Skill，也不要求用户选引擎或填状态表。开源能力的发现、试用、接入、更新与替换见入口的 [能力迭代参考](../skills/self-media-workflow/references/open-source-capabilities.md)。

| 项目 Skill（`skills/`） | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| self-media-workflow | 从需求到实际成品，按需选择能力并持续改进 |
| content-authoring | 故事线、技术解释、口播、脚本、图文与封面文案 |
| technical-handdraw-video | 内容需要时使用逐步描线与准确声音 |
| multi-platform-publish | 按指定文件、平台、账号和时间完成界面操作并回读结果 |
| guizang-social-card-skill | 第三方图文卡片与封面（固定版本，见 `skills.lock.json`） |
| jianying-editor-skill | 第三方剪映工程依赖，只经 `tools/video/` 调用，不作为入口 |

`skills/` 是项目使用的唯一源码。通用方法改进先改这里；若某个 Skill 另有个人库权威源码，修改前核对双方差异，通用方法同步回个人库，作品材料、机器路径、账号和项目特例只留本项目。

## 各 Agent 如何读取

规则只写在 [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)。各 Agent 的接入层只负责让它找到规则和 Skill，不另写规则：

| Agent | 规则 | Skill |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Claude Code | `CLAUDE.md` 引用 `AGENTS.md` | `.claude/skills/<名称>` 是指向 `skills/<名称>` 的链接 |
| 读取 `AGENTS.md` 的其他 Agent | 直接读 `AGENTS.md` | 按各自机制安装或链接 `skills/`；`skills/*/agents/` 下是该 Agent 的展示元数据 |

新增 Agent 时只加它的入口文件和指向 `skills/` 的链接。新增项目 Skill 时放进 `skills/`，再为每个已接入的 Agent 补一个链接。

## 外部 Skill 依赖

`tools/video/scripts/jianying_direct.py` 需要在本机安装 `jianying-direct-call`。查找顺序：`JY_DIRECT_SKILL_ROOT`，然后是各 Agent 的用户 Skill 目录（`~/.claude/skills`、`~/.agents/skills`、`~/.codex/skills`），最后是个人库同步配置。用户级的 `ui-design-lab`、`talking-head-polish` 等可选能力不随项目分发，可用时由入口选择。

第三方源码的版本、许可与补丁见 [组件说明](components.md) 和 `skills.lock.json`；`python3 scripts/verify_skills.py` 在维护时核对固定文件。

The project now works with any agent. All rules live in one file, `AGENTS.md`. Claude Code reaches it through a thin `CLAUDE.md`, and nothing in the Claude setup depends on the old Codex setup. I didn't commit or stage anything, and your existing uncommitted edits are untouched.

**One shared rule set, a thin layer per agent**
- **`AGENTS.md`** stays the only rules file. I replaced the line that named Codex tools (CodeGraph, `.codex`) with neutral wording: each agent's entry file only points to `AGENTS.md`, skill source code lives in `skills/`, and each agent's own config folder belongs to that agent.
- **`CLAUDE.md`** (new) loads `AGENTS.md` and adds four Claude Code notes: start daily work from `self-media-workflow`, how project skills are linked, how optional user-level skills fit in, and run long renders in the background.
- **`.claude/skills/`** (new) has links to the five project skills: self-media-workflow, content-authoring, multi-platform-publish, technical-handdraw-video and guizang-social-card-skill. The skill files exist only once, in `skills/`, so there are no copies to keep in sync. I left out `jianying-editor-skill` because it's only used through `tools/video/`.
- **`.claude/settings.json`** (new) puts your no-auto-commit rule into Claude Code's permissions. Commit, push, staging the whole tree, reset, clean, and reading `.local/accounts` or `.local/publishing` all ask you first. `.claude/settings.local.json` is now in `.gitignore` for personal overrides.

**Streamlining**
- **History docs:** I deleted `docs/creator-flow-simplification-plan.md` and `docs/refactor-sessions/`, about 105 KB of history. They're committed, so `git show HEAD:<path>` brings them back. The README now says history lives in git.
- **`docs/skill-library.md`:** rewritten without Codex sync details or old session notes. It's now a skill table, a table of how each agent reads rules and skills, and the steps for adding a new agent or skill.
- **`tools/video/scripts/jianying_direct.py`:** it used to look for `jianying-direct-call` only through Codex paths. It now checks `~/.claude/skills`, `~/.agents/skills` and `~/.codex/skills` first, then the personal-library sync config as a last resort. On this machine it still picks the same copy as before.

**Checks:** all 49 tests in `tools/video/tests` pass, `scripts/verify_skills.py` matched all 230 pinned files, and the settings file is valid JSON. I haven't yet opened a fresh Claude Code session to confirm the five skills show up through the links.

Two things I left alone because they're your uncommitted work. Both clash with the project's own rules:
- `tools/视频制作方法沉淀.tar.gz` is an archive, which the rules say not to produce by default.
- `tools/视频制作方法总览.md` and `research/` hold research notes. `tools/` is meant for production tools, and `research/` isn't part of the documented folder layout.

They might belong under `workspace/_shared/` or in a specific work's folder. Tell me where and I'll move them.
However, the skill here is specific to the implementation of Codex, and it may not necessarily apply to you

- content-authoring: Turn a confirmed self-media theme and evidence into video scripts, platform-native copy, visual briefs, and requested publishing fields without one-size-fits-all rewriting.

72	# Narrative knowledge animation
73	
74	Read when designing a new narrative or substantially changing its visual explanation. This reference owns story, causal relationships, shot expression and comprehension difficulties. Reuse the established narrative for local corrections.
75	
76	## Design the viewer's journey
77	
78	Settle three questions in the existing script or storyboard:
79	
80	- What familiar action, surprising result or unresolved problem gives the viewer a reason to watch?
81	- What object, image, signal or data can the viewer follow?
82	- What visible result answers the opening question, and what evidence supports it?
83	
84	Build a causal sequence around that subject. Preserve identity and spatial cues across whole-object/detail views and cuts. Each substantive shot should show what changed, why, and what the viewer can now understand. Captions name or qualify the event; repeated labels or rotation of an unchanged model do not demonstrate a mechanism.
85	
86	Carry one stage's output into the next. For small changes such as denoising, choose an informative sample, stable region or controlled comparison that remains visible at delivery size. Keep the final computed result through the reveal instead of replacing it with an unrelated polished image. Mark synthesized teaching inputs and illustrative values honestly.
87	
88	For experiments, show relevant conditions, intervention and measured result; a controlled failure/correction is useful only when evidence supports it. Present readable terminal/instrument evidence at the corresponding moment. Distinguish recordings, reconstructions and illustrative animation. For other subjects, retain their own explanatory structure.
89	
90	Carry `content-authoring`'s concrete case and causal reasoning into the shots. Use `ui-design-lab`'s relationship layouts, identity/state vocabulary and reading guidance when needed; preserve the accepted content and direction rather than adopting a reference's topic, palette or runtime wholesale.
91	
92	## Make mechanisms observable
93	
94	- Define input, state, trigger, visible action, output and invariant. Comparisons keep unrelated conditions stable.
95	- Model the parts/connections needed to explain behavior. Keep geometry and callouts in one coordinate system through zooms and exploded views; inspect close views at delivery size.
96	- Drive shapes, counters, labels, highlights and captions from the same evaluated state/timeline. Waiting, transition and valid-output phases must agree.
97	- Check important states against an independent calculation/source and inspect the rendered values. Calling the same state helper again does not prove the picture uses it correctly.
98	- Separate pedagogical structure, physical geometry and measured hardware behavior. Plausible generated imagery is not device evidence.
99	
100	Reuse a mechanism as geometry/materials plus behavior, a representative scene and relevant checks. A static model export does not imply editable logic or animation.
101	
102	## Validate the creative choice before expanding
103	
104	For a [representative segment](video-production.md#make-a-representative-segment), choose a central explanation and difficult transition rather than merely the most crowded overview. Compare revisions at the same explanatory moment and preserve enough of the prior artifact for that comparison.
105	
106	| Question | Look for | If weak |
107	| --- | --- | --- |
108	| Does one question connect opening, mechanism and payoff? | A recurring case, relevant conditions and a visible answer | Ground abstract terms in an audience task; reconnect detached beats or remove repetition within scope |
109	| Does the picture show cause and result? | An operation/action cue connected to an object or state change | Add the missing operation or relation; shared colors alone do not demonstrate a reference's method |
110	| Can the viewer follow identity and current state? | Stable labels/anchors, distinct relationships and valid simultaneous states | Correct misleading object splits, exclusive-state displays or accumulated highlights |
111	| Are choices and evidence comparable? | Requirements before solutions, matching comparison fields and relevant cost/limits | Restore missing conditions; separate unrelated side topics |
112	| Is the information readable in sequence? | One leading event, readable labels, subtitle space and useful holds | Reduce concurrent fields, reveal results successively or reframe; higher resolution alone cannot fix density |
113	
114	Compare the script with the actual pictures at the same explanatory moment. A script-only review uses the supplied writing; an export review inspects the export. Tie defects to a beat/time/frame and their effect on understanding. Distinguish a shot-design problem from a local rendering bug, then inspect the affected revision and transitions.
115	
116	Use [export checks](video-production.md#verify-the-export) for technical media, playback, listening and acceptance. Design judgment and machine checks do not establish audience retention or replace normal-speed comprehension review.

118	# Improve and integrate production capabilities
119	
120	Read when a current production problem, desired expression, user feedback or upstream change warrants a capability improvement. Proactively discover useful GitHub methods/tools for that need without requiring the user to name a repository. Do not rescan the ecosystem for routine edits or create a scheduled monitoring service.
121	
122	## Discover for the actual gap
123	
124	Name the observed gap first: an unreadable Chinese title, a missing code transition, inaccurate subtitle timing, a slow render or a needed sound treatment. Compare the existing tool's relevant behavior before searching for a replacement. Read [optional candidates](tool-candidates.md) only when a shortlist helps that comparison; it does not replace discovery beyond the list.
125	
126	Use connected GitHub repository/code search when available, otherwise GitHub search or a web search restricted to primary sources. Search the capability, language and interface, for example `canvas deterministic video render`, `Chinese subtitle alignment`, or `text measurement typography`. Inspect the selected repository's current default branch/release, implementation, license and minimal dependencies. An old link returning 404 calls for repository tree inspection, not an invented path. Do not install an entire Skill collection to read one relevant method.
127	
128	For versioned packages, inspect the version used by the existing engine, package exports and actual runtime requirements. Preserve code and asset licenses separately. Code permission does not authorize demonstration music, voices, photos or fonts. Unknown reuse rights preclude copying those assets; a technique can still be studied without copying its implementation.
129	
130	## Trial, adopt and make callable
131	
132	Choose the smallest useful integration: apply a method to existing source, import a compatible library, or invoke the upstream native CLI. Keep trial inputs and outputs inside the affected work. Try actual language, dimensions, difficult text/action and intended audio; include editing and re-export if modification cost is the problem. Measure one task's runtime/resource use before increasing concurrency.
133	
134	Inspect the actual output and the source that generated it. A package installation, demo or successful exit is insufficient. For video trials, use the relevant [representative-segment](video-production.md#make-a-representative-segment), [sound](video-production.md#work-with-sound) and [export](video-production.md#verify-the-export) criteria instead of adding a second review procedure. Correct or reject an adoption that fails.
135	
136	When useful, add the exact command/API, inputs, output, adopted version, license and necessary limitation to the existing tool documentation or the relevant Skill reference. Link it from the task's normal production branch. Preserve lockfiles and required licenses; add only missing connection code, without a plugin registry or uniform engine framework. Distinguish native execution, code adaptation, design reference and investigated-but-unused; identify the adopted revision, actual invocation/implementation and concrete contribution in an existing source note or delivery explanation.
137	
138	If the user explicitly requires a named Skill or pipeline to run, verify its actual invocation and output. A similar implementation or design reference does not fulfill that requirement; report any unavailable execution route and continue independent authorized work.
139	
140	## Update or replace
141	
142	For a relevant bugfix or new need, compare upstream changes with the pinned version and existing local adaptations. Keep the currently working dependency and source intact while testing the candidate in an isolated installation or output directory. Re-run the same representative case and a local edit. Update the lockfile, command reference and affected Skill only after a useful result; ongoing works keep their chosen version until explicitly migrated.
143	
144	Remove superseded adapters after checking callers. Retain old work sources, exports and licenses. If the trial adds maintenance or yields no useful improvement, keep the current route. No new scorecard, approval package, integration ledger or retrospective report is required.
145	
146	## Example: measured text
147	
148	The Remotion official Skill's [text measurement method](https://github.com/remotion-dev/skills/blob/6c67adcd9cdbe6eb84d76342da89b225f9161cb2/skills/remotion-markup/measuring-text.md) recommends loading fonts before measuring and matching the font properties used by the actual text. `@remotion/layout-utils` exposes `measureText`, `fitText` and `fillTextBox`; inspect the engine-compatible package version and its own license before use. Use a minimum readable font size: if fitting would make the title too small, change line breaks/layout instead. Measurement prevents overflow; it does not decide hierarchy, composition or reading time.
149	
150	This is one callable method to consider for a text-fit problem, not a default renderer or a whitelist. Other work may need image processing, sound, subtitle, geometry or rendering capabilities instead.

170	# Video production
171	
172	Read the relevant section when making, revising or reviewing a video. This reference owns production inputs, engine selection, sound, rendering and export checks. Project instructions and the current work supply directories and output specifications; the main Skill owns delivery boundaries.
173	
174	## Establish the production brief
175	
176	Recover the audience, intended conclusion and evidence; dimensions/frame rate/duration; visual direction; exact voice/music; available source and requested outputs from the current work. Ask only about missing choices that affect the result. Keep editing inputs even when they are not separate delivery items.
177	
178	For a continuation, rebuild or named reference, inspect relevant scenes of the actual film and its feedback. Separate the reference's explanatory method from its palette, topic, runtime or assets; check reuse rights before importing material. Use the existing script or shot plan without creating an additional brief or approval document.
179	
180	## Choose the route after the narrative
181	
182	Select narrative, shot presentation, shared visual identity and engine separately. Different shots may use footage, diagrams or comparisons while retaining consistent object identities; a single treatment is equally valid when it serves the film. Keep a working engine unless the requested result requires a change.
183	
184	| Material and intent | Production route |
185	| --- | --- |
186	| New causal narrative or substantial visual rebuild | [Narrative animation](narrative-animation.md), then the appropriate existing engine |
187	| Explicitly selected progressive technical drawing | `technical-handdraw-video` and its available engine |
188	| Editable diagrams, data graphics or signal animation | Existing scene/render commands; `ui-design-lab` for visual work when useful |
189	| 3D structure, cutaway or mechanism | Existing model/scene sources and verified renderer; no separate 3D Skill is required |
190	| Existing spoken commentary, tutorial, review or interview | `talking-head-polish` when applicable; burn editable overlays with the project's shared overlay command instead of a per-work renderer copy; preserve required speech and original media |
191	| Recorded experiment, screen capture or montage | Existing editing workflow; an animated experiment does not prove it ran |
192	
193	Load a capability for a specific shot need, not a topic keyword, recent installation or attractive demo. A renderer does not determine style. When something is missing, use [open-source capabilities](open-source-capabilities.md) for discovery and adoption; candidates are loaded only when comparison is needed. Project requirements take precedence over upstream defaults for audio, dimensions, directories and extra workflow steps.
194	
195	## Make a representative segment
196	
197	Use a small segment for a new visual direction, new voice, changed critical tool or substantial rebuild. Include the hardest explanatory action/transition, actual language, dimensions and intended sound. Choose coverage by risk, not a fixed duration. Judge explanatory quality with the [narrative criteria](narrative-animation.md#validate-the-creative-choice-before-expanding) when relevant, then apply the export checks below. Established routes can render directly; a local correction checks the affected segment and its downstream effects without reopening settled choices.
198	
199	## Work with sound
200	
201	Use actual audio boundaries for shot timing. Keep display and spoken text distinct when pronunciation requires it. If speech overruns, adjust wording or allocate time; preserve word endings. Reuse accurate narration for visual-only edits, and never substitute a requested voice because its service is unavailable. A new voice needs actual listening before batch production.
202	
203	Find the exact selected music/sound identity and reusable local file before fetching anything. Use an available resource capability only for missing or changed material within authorization. Retrieval, synthesis, editor export and rights are different facts. Keep speech intelligible; compare music-led revisions with the accepted mix instead of applying a universal loudness target. Check the final encoded mix after sound changes.
204	
205	## Render the requested change
206	
207	Use the work's existing native render or subtitle-composition command and editable inputs. Read that command's usage as needed, keep prior exports, and write to a new output. Render affected intervals for iteration; produce the full result when the requested delivery needs it. Preserve the work's specifications rather than accepting a tool's unrelated defaults.
208	
209	For programmatic animation, prefer direct frame evaluation when supported. Check repeat seeking when hidden history could change the rendered result.
210	
211	## Verify the export
212	
213	Scale verification to the change and establish source/artifact correspondence before reusing previous results.
214	
215	- Inspect affected frames, transitions, camera extremes, final state and text at intended viewing size. For a complete film or substantial rebuild, cover the whole export with distributed samples and targeted motion; an opening sample cannot validate the middle or ending. Inspect required cover exports for framing, text and dimensions against project requirements.
216	- Check actual dimensions, duration, frame rate, tracks and full decoding. When sound/timing changes, inspect narration/subtitle/action alignment, cut word endings and masking; confirm unchanged audio remains intact for visual-only edits.
217	- Distinguish normal-speed playback, actual listening, comprehension and author acceptance. A muted browser run proves none of the latter three. Use an available capable review route, or report what was not done without blocking independently completed work.
218	
219	Wait for asynchronous checks to finish and inspect their actual result and output. After a fix, repeat the affected checks against the new export. Preserve useful failure evidence; do not replay passed checks or accumulate reports without a new change or unresolved concern.

221	---
222	name: content-authoring
223	description: Turn a confirmed self-media theme and evidence into video scripts, platform-native copy, visual briefs, and requested publishing fields without one-size-fits-all rewriting.
224	---
225	
226	# Content authoring
227	
228	Use to clarify a single content brief or create video scripts and platform-native drafts from the requested theme. Do not use it for publishing, data analysis, or a production pipeline that needs a specialized video skill.
229	
230	## Clarify only material choices
231	
232	First inspect supplied sources and project context, including the project's creator context file when it defines one (positioning, audience, voice, series); do not re-derive positioning it already settles. Confirm audience, objective, core claim, evidence, chosen platforms, format, tone, exclusions, and commercial relationship only where missing information changes the draft. Use reasonable defaults when the brief supports them; ask only about an unresolved choice that materially changes the work.
233	
234	## Write from evidence
235	
236	Separate verified facts, the author's judgment, inference, and advice. Do not add brands, people, metrics, results, or promises unsupported by the evidence. Use explicit placeholders for facts needing human verification.
237	
238	When titles or platform drafts are requested, create multiple internal title approaches, remove those the body cannot fulfill, and present a small useful selection when alternatives are requested. Design each selected platform independently: its opening, evidence order, density, examples, call to action, tags, and disclosure may differ. Shared facts are not a reason to reuse one body unchanged.
239	
240	## Video script path
241	
242	For a video script, start with the viewer's question, the answer or change the film will demonstrate, and the available material. Then write a compact sequence of narrative beats with the spoken or on-screen claim, visual action or evidence, and sound cue only where it affects timing or meaning. Decide the production method, engine, voice source, and detailed shot plan afterwards with the production workflow; do not presume hand-drawing, a web preview, a cover, or platform fields.
243	
244	When the creator speaks from their own experience — spoken commentary, a series episode, or narration over screen recordings — read [spoken commentary](references/spoken-commentary.md) for claim marking, the opening hook, spoken Chinese, platform copy and the pre-delivery self-review.
245	
246	For a mechanism explanation, debugging story or technical design choice, read [technical explanation](references/technical-explanation.md). It connects a concrete case, causal reasoning, alternatives and evidence to the visual handoff. Apply it to the requested script work without starting production or imposing a fault-and-fix story on unrelated content.
247	
248	One brief or script may hold the premise, evidence, narration and visual cues. Do not require a separate treatment, storyboard, title set, cover brief, or publishing package unless the request needs it. If the theme is genuinely undecided, ask only for the choice that changes the script.
249	
250	## Image posts and covers
251	
252	Organize pages by the question each answers and the evidence/image it needs. Preserve a continuous example or visual object when it helps the reader; page count follows the content. Keep copy and visual cues in the same working source where practical. Complete works follow the project's cover-ratio requirements. Reuse the title and central visual across variants, while reflowing text and moving/scaling the subject for each composition.
253	
254	For topic discovery, start from the audience's concrete question and available evidence. Check changing facts at primary sources; a popular reference is a lead, not proof of a general rule. Do not create a calendar, account strategy or analytics report unless the user requested it.
255	
256	## Visual and material boundaries
257	
258	When the request includes visual production, give a visual brief tied to each page, shot, or claim. Reuse existing decisions instead of adding another approval checkpoint. Use only user-authorized, licensed, public-domain, or generated material with documented rights; public availability alone is not reuse permission. For social-card or slide production, discover an installed compatible tool such as `guizang-social-card-skill` or `html-ppt`; they are optional external capabilities, not this skill's dependency.
259	
260	Deliver the requested script or copy, material/rights notes, and outstanding verification items. Add titles, platform drafts, release fields, or visual briefs only when requested or required by the selected destination. A draft never means a platform action is authorized.
261	
262	Keep quotations brief and attributed when a source requires it. Do not turn a reference style into a claim of sponsorship, endorsement, or measured result.
263	
264	## Attribution
265	
266	Adapted from `yanhua1010/self-media-content-workflow` at pinned commit `cf2526942a9f68ff80e1ac77031cd68d8383ec6c` (MIT); see `LICENSE`.

268	# Spoken commentary and screen-recording scripts
269	
270	Read when the work is the creator speaking from their own experience, alone or over screen recordings and demonstrations. The aim is a specific person telling what actually happened, not an article read aloud. Mechanism explanations inside such a video still use [technical explanation](technical-explanation.md) for that beat.
271	
272	## Material before words
273	
274	Read the project's creator context when one exists (positioning, voice, series, platform rules). Personal experience comes only from the creator's own notes, transcripts, chats, commits, terminal output, screenshots or direct answers. When a beat needs an experience that is not in the material, ask one concrete question ("那次 AI 改坏了什么？你怎么发现的？") or leave a visible gap; never write a plausible one.
275	
276	While drafting, mark every sentence that carries an experience, fact, number or opinion. Strip the marks from narration and subtitles; keep them in the draft the creator reviews.
277	
278	| Mark | Meaning | On air |
279	| --- | --- | --- |
280	| 【经历】 | Happened to the creator; cite the note, transcript line or file | First person, concrete |
281	| 【事实·来源】 | Checkable; cite the document/version or the command output | State plainly |
282	| 【判断】 | The creator's opinion | Keep "我觉得 / 我现在的看法" |
283	| 【推测】 | Reasonable inference not yet checked | Say so: "我猜 / 可能" |
284	| 【待补：…】 | Needed and missing | Must be resolved or listed before delivery |
285	
286	## Open with the strongest line in the material
287	
288	The first sentence is not background, date or greeting ("今年三月份…", "大家好，今天聊…"). Look through the material for a reversal, a concrete cost, a number, a self-question or a quotable line — often it is already there, buried near the end. Write three candidate openings of different kinds, discard any the body cannot pay off, and recommend one:
289	
290	- **反差**: the outcome contradicted the expectation.
291	- **代价**: what it actually cost (time, sleep, a broken board, a rewrite).
292	- **观众的问题**: the question the target viewer is already asking.
293	- **画面**: a screen state that explains itself — a failing build, a diff, a terminal result.
294	
295	Chronology can follow the hook. For an already-recorded take, do not rewrite the speech: carry the hook through the cover title, the first overlay or caption, or propose a re-recorded first line the creator can choose to add.
296	
297	## Body: one claim, concrete beats
298	
299	State the central claim in one sentence before drafting; a second claim is a second video. Each beat carries what I did, what happened and what changed in my understanding, with at least one specific detail: tool, model, file, error, command, board, how long it took. Prefer the observable ("它直接读项目改代码，我只负责编译、下载、调试") over the abstract ("AI 大幅提升了效率"). Keep boundary statements ("该上板测试还得上板") — they are why an engineer is believed.
300	
301	For a screen-recording beat, state what to record, what must be readable at phone size, and how long to hold it. Record the real tool and real output; a reconstructed or mocked screen is labelled as such or not used. Never stage a result that did not happen.
302	
303	## Spoken Chinese
304	
305	- One idea per sentence; breath-length clauses (about 8–15 字). Split anything over about 25 字.
306	- Use the creator's own connectors and expressions from the context file or transcripts. Avoid writing-register phrases they do not use: 首先/其次/综上所述、赋能、颠覆、一文读懂、硬核干货、保姆级、宝子们.
307	- Read each line aloud. If the creator would not say it to a colleague, rewrite it.
308	- Keep display text and spoken text separate where pronunciation differs (`I2C` → "I 方 C").
309	- Estimate duration from the creator's measured speaking rate; without one, assume about 5 字/秒 and say it is an assumption.
310	
311	## Ending
312	
313	Return to the opening question and give one sentence the viewer can repeat. If inviting comments, ask a real question the viewer can answer from their own work, not "点赞关注". Tease the next episode only when it exists in the series plan.
314	
315	## Platform copy
316	
317	Write each platform separately; the body must deliver what the title promises.
318	
319	- **Douyin**: title is the hook or question; description one to three short sentences — the video carries the content.
320	- **Xiaohongshu**: title is a concrete claim or question (field limit is short — check it on the live form); body in short paragraphs that stand without the video, a takeaway list is fine when it is real.
321	- **Hashtags**: the project's required tags verbatim, plus two to four specific content tags (`#ClaudeCode` over `#科技`).
322	- **AI disclosure**: state AI assistance where AI wrote, voiced or generated material, as the platform form requires.
323	
324	## Deliverable format
325	
326	```
327	核心观点：一句话
328	开头候选：A（反差）/ B（代价）/ C（问题） → 推荐 A，理由
329	| # | 口播 | 画面 / 录屏 | 标记与来源 |
330	预计时长：N 字 ÷ 语速 = 约 M 秒
331	待补：…
332	```
333	
334	## Self-review before delivery
335	
336	Report each item as pass or the specific failing line; fix what you can first.
337	
338	1. The first sentence is a hook, not background, and the body pays it off.
339	2. The central claim fits in one sentence; every beat serves it.
340	3. Every experience/fact/number has a mark and a source; no invented 【经历】; open 【待补】 are listed.
341	4. Every beat has a concrete detail; no sentence over about 25 字 without a pause; no writing-register phrases.
342	5. The ending answers the opening.
343	6. Platform titles are fulfilled by the body; required hashtags match the project text exactly.
344	7. Estimated duration matches the target.
345	
346	A script review checks the writing. It does not establish how the recording sounds or how viewers will respond.

348	# Technical explanations: content and visual handoff
349	
350	Read when writing or substantially revising a video that explains a mechanism, diagnoses a failure or compares technical choices. Use the relevant parts for a narrow revision. This is a content method, not a requirement for a particular engine, palette, duration or number of scenes.
351	
352	## Give the viewer a concrete question
353	
354	Start with an action or decision the audience can recognize, the expected result, and the observed result or constraint. Show the consequence that makes the distinction matter. A pair of surprising numbers can introduce a question, but connect it to the actual work, data or user outcome. Keep the condition that makes the claim true visible in the premise.
355	
356	Carry one useful case through the explanation: the same input, objects and identifiers should recur in the mechanism, proposed change and evidence. Introduce a new example when it resolves a different question; explain the transition instead of making the viewer reconstruct the context.
357	
358	Choose a progression suited to the task:
359	
360	| Explanation | Useful progression | Evidence to preserve |
361	| --- | --- | --- |
362	| A reproducible failure | Recognizable symptom → relevant code or action → causal sequence → correction and cost → comparable result | The failing condition, changed cause and fields that establish the difference |
363	| A mechanism or surprising behavior | Concrete input → persistent objects and state → trigger → visible consequence → scope of the explanation | What remains constant, what changes and why the result follows |
364	| A design choice | Requirement → competing approaches on the same case → relevant tradeoffs → decision under stated conditions | Common inputs and comparison criteria; limits of each approach |
365	
366	These are possible reasoning structures, not mandatory chapter lists. Do not invent a failure, measurement or dramatic reversal to fit one. Demonstrate the distinction before naming the abstraction when that makes the explanation easier to follow; introduce prerequisites before the viewer needs them.
367	
368	## Explain the cause, then the choice
369	
370	Locate the operation or assumption that produces the result. Pair the relevant code, field or rule with its effect on the same object over time. Distinguish what the system guarantees from what the application or caller must arrange. Exclude plausible alternative causes only when the evidence supports doing so.
371	
372	Before proposing a fix, establish the requirement it satisfies. For example, keeping only a current state and retaining every event are different requirements; they need not share a solution. When alternatives matter, show them against the same case and explain the cost or responsibility that changes. Do not label one approach universally correct because it works in the example.
373	
374	Keep boundary conditions beside the claim or choice they qualify. Retain a warning when it changes correctness, safety or the viewer's decision. Move an independent tutorial or repeated explanation out of the main sequence when the authorized scope permits; avoid ending with a pile of unrelated API facts. For an approved script or preservation request, identify the structural issue without silently deleting its content.
375	
376	## Hand off an explanation the picture can carry
377	
378	Use the existing script or storyboard to connect each central beat:
379	
380	**Viewer's question → claim and condition → object or evidence → visible change → result carried forward.**
381	
382	Specify only what the visual maker needs:
383	
384	- Which object, value, address, resource or actor keeps its identity across the beat, and which property changes.
385	- The causal verb the picture should show: copy, retain, overwrite, reference, queue, consume, transfer, compare or another action supported by the source. A title and a paragraph alone do not specify that action.
386	- Which code line, trace field or measurement supports the explanation; retain source context and distinguish measured evidence from teaching diagrams.
387	- What the next beat inherits, so definitions, mechanism, correction and comparison remain connected.
388	
389	For example, if several records refer to one changing buffer, keep record identities distinct, keep the shared buffer identifiable, and show its successive updates before the later read. A comparison can then change how the payload is retained while keeping the input and result fields comparable. This is an illustrative shot pattern, not a claim about an untested API or runtime.
390	
391	Let narration explain the reasoning while diagram labels name objects, conditions and results. Preserve requested subtitles; do not require a complicated technical diagram to communicate every qualification without speech. The chosen visual workflow determines layout, graphic vocabulary and motion from this handoff.
392	
393	## Review the content against the intended picture
394	
395	Read the opening and ending together: can the ending answer the same question under the stated conditions? Follow the recurring example through the middle: is each inference supported, and does every substantial beat change the viewer's understanding or decision?
396	
397	Check that alternatives use comparable inputs and fields, boundary notes stay relevant, and the handoff identifies an observable cause and result rather than restating narration. Record a weak beat and its proposed change in the existing review. A script review can establish this structure; an unrendered visual cue cannot establish that the final picture communicates it successfully.

399	---
400	name: technical-handdraw-video
401	description: 将技术资料或讲解稿制作成完整有声手绘视频。用于明确需要逐步手绘讲解的成片或修订；不用于真人口播精剪、静态图、一般视频制作或平台发布。
402	---
403	
404	# 技术手绘视频
405	
406	仅在内容需要逐步手绘讲解时使用。项目的明确约束优先，以下不额外建立通用审批流程。交付请求的 MP4；保留准确声音、可编辑源和必要时序。完整作品遵循项目的封面比例要求，分别构图；外挂字幕、工程包和 ZIP 按需。先读实际源与相关反馈；用户只要脚本或分镜时止于该产物。
407	
408	## 选择运行能力
409	
410	读取本机配置或已安装技能，定位 `sweety-handdraw-video`（环境变量 `HANDDRAW_SKILL_DIR` 也可指定）。它是外部依赖，不位于本技能的相对项目路径内。需要渲染时读 [引擎与验收](references/runtime-and-review.md)；需要剪映音色时读 [指定配音](references/jianying-voice.md)。用户选择 `jianying-direct-call` 时，复用其规范实现和明确标记的 SAMI 通道生成分段音频，再离线驱动画面；不打开剪映，也不复制协议实现。没有引擎可继续稿件，不把无声样段交付为完整成片。
411	
412	## 制作
413	
414	1. **技术结论。** 将关键主张映射到一手来源、版本和限定，独立核对计算。原理示意、受控实验和真实硬件结果分别表述，私有源只取已授权公开的表达。
415	2. **叙事与分镜。** 从观众问题、可验证结论和已有素材出发，先写可画出的叙事节拍，再选手绘对象、状态变化与镜头。长内容仅在用户要求系列或单片无法完成目标时拆分。维持对象、颜色、状态连续，每个动作解释关系。
416	3. **声音与时序。** 保留技术显示 `text` 与合成 `spoken_text`，按稳定段 ID 对应。指定音色按真实来源核对，不因 API 或服务缺失静默换声；取得实际音频后才锁定时码。已有准确音频可直接驱动时间线，无需剪映工程。
417	4. **原生画面。** 从当前任务/用户偏好取画幅与分辨率，未给规格时提出适合内容的默认值；不固化某台机器的4K偏好。文字、公式、比特和箭头用可编辑图层。横屏要重排空间，不拉伸竖版成片。增加元素时优先选择能够解释本题关系的对象、状态变化、时间轴、组件堆叠、比较表或决策路径；按语义分阶段揭示，保留固定对象和颜色含义。高分辨率图解仅在明确交付需要时另附。
418	5. **编排与渲染。** 用真实音频活动区间生成必要的烧录字幕和动作，逐步描线/填色并留出阅读时间。不要靠加速声音掩盖过密画面。音乐、提示音按需要加入并检查遮蔽。
419	6. **代表段与全片。** 新画风、新声音、引擎变更或高风险动作先用含术语和换页的代表段核验；已验证路线的局部修订只核受影响段及下游影响。然后渲染最终 MP4，检查每页完成图、动作窗、必要字幕、首尾及连续播放；声音另外核验。
420	
421	## 修订与交付
422	
423	修订保留旧源、音频与输出，只重新核验受影响的时序和布局。直接交付实际成片，不要求项目状态推进、批准命令、审核记录或引擎交付回执。若上游总控强制额外流程，调用其可独立使用的制作层或选择其他适用能力；不伪造审核状态。
424	
425	检查工程、图像/动作和最终声音。无法实际听音时如实说明；波形、ASR 或信号相关性不等于自然度、发音正确。说明实际规格、声音来源与检查范围；后续发布进入 [multi-platform-publish](../multi-platform-publish/SKILL.md)。
426	=================== skills/technical-handdraw-video/references/jianying-voice.md (4015)
427	# 指定剪映音色
428	
429	用户指定“猪猪侠”等音色时，卡片可能显示“GG侠”等名称，以当前界面和可核对声音来源为准。名称相似、通用 TTS 或某包装器叫 Jianying 都不证明支持同一音色。
430	
431	按用户已选择的声音来源执行。已明确选择 `jianying-direct-call` 的无界面路径时，先读该 Skill 及配音参考，用其 SAMI 通道；如实记录 `backend=sami`、`native_rest_equivalence_verified=false`。此路径不是已复现的剪映原生 REST，也不宣称是官方公开 API。没有这项选择时，优先核验确实支持所需音色的官方 API，再按已有授权使用剪映原生界面。不因 VoiceStudio 缺失回退别的音色。登录/会员/新增付费是真实单独条件，制作授权不自动授权购买。
432	
433	## 无界面分段配音
434	
435	定位当前可用的 `jianying-direct-call` Skill，读取其配音参考并复用原有入口；项目已有音段适配器时，从项目 SOP 获取命令和参数，不复制网络协议。每段保留稳定 ID、准确显示文本和实际合成文本，并在当前版本记录二者与音频的对应。
436	
437	1. 查询音色资源，核对实际 `voice.voice_type`。保留资源 ID、原始音色名称与许可字段冲突；资源可用或合成成功都不证明商用许可与账户权益。
438	2. 先生成包含本片困难术语的单段，核对真实容器、解码时长和完整性。主观听感另记，不能由成功码推断。
439	3. 外部配音仅发送当前片的朗读文本，不发送知识库原页、账号记录、凭据或无关资料。若执行审批拒绝外发，保留审核稿并说明拒绝来源；取得明确许可后才继续，不切换工具规避。
440	4. 继续其余段落，每段只请求一次。按真实容器保存输出，用现有 FFmpeg 明确转为 WAV。逐段记录文本与 speaker 指纹、源/解码哈希、实际时长及通道；已记录且哈希未变的音频可续用。文本/音色改变就创建新版本。结果不明、孤立输出或服务失败先检查，不自动重试或换声。
441	5. 用实际 WAV 构建手绘时间线；分别审核显示术语与朗读表达、最终音轨、音画关系。`audio_subjective=not_checked` 不能写成已经试听。
442	
443	资源库位置、协议参考和本地快照参数按实际能力的说明传入。无法读取实时资源库时，只复用可追溯到本任务的已核验快照，核对资源 ID 与 speaker；不臆造元数据。配音证据留在任务记录中，不进入 Skill 或公开包。能力缺失时先完成独立的稿件与画面工作，不把未执行的合成记为成功。
444	
445	## 剪映原生界面路径
446	
447	1. 保留 `narration.json` 段 ID、准确显示文本和送入合成的 spoken_text；术语按发音需要展开，屏幕仍保留准确技术写法。
448	2. 新建本篇独立草稿，不覆盖用户工程。导入 SRT/文本后回读完整段落和顺序；临时槽位只为隔离各段，长度要容纳实际语音，不作为最终视频时码。
449	3. 新音色先验证含困难术语的片段，再生成其他段。已有核验声音无需重生成。等待真实音轨，核对段数与活动区域。
450	4. 原生导出完整 WAV/SRT，检查路径、编码、时长、哈希、文本一致性、漏段、重叠及尾音。Qt 文本框可能吞输入，导出前回读文件名。剪贴板不可完整备份恢复时改用其他方法。
451	5. 按实测槽位/片段边界与采样索引派生各段，保存源/目标哈希和切分范围。不能把某次20秒槽长写成固定契约；语音越界就重排/重导出，不强切或加速。
452	6. 以准确分段音频驱动最终时间线、字幕与动作，保留轻尾音余量。最终 MP4 音轨另行解码检查，并尽可能试听；信号一致不证明发音和主观听感。
453	
454	剪映 WAV 导出与手绘引擎 MP4 导出分别记录，不能统称剪映整片导出。界面句柄、坐标、用户目录和应用位置每机重新发现，不复制旧任务操作脚本。
455	=================== skills/technical-handdraw-video/references/runtime-and-review.md (3020)
456	# 引擎、契约与验收
457	
458	外部引擎来源：`threerocks/sweety-handdraw-video`，仓库外部依赖清单锁定版本。按库根 README 的安装命令安装引擎，或通过 `HANDDRAW_SKILL_DIR`/本机配置指向已有安装。不要复制旧电脑绝对路径或把当前工作目录当引擎位置。
459	
460	先读该版本引擎的 `SKILL.md`、依赖说明、相关运行接口，确认真实 CLI 和 schema。生产任务放独立工作目录，不能写入技能安装目录。字体、声音、图像来源从当前机器核验，不分发系统字体或私有素材。
461	
462	常用任务契约包含 design.json、script.md、narration.json、job.json、inputs、work/timeline.json、outputs；以实际引擎版本为准。图像美术指导与已看图证据绑定图像哈希，准确文字和标注由编辑图层生成。
463	
464	已有 CLI 的示例（先检查是否附加不适用的项目流程；有项目直接渲染适配时优先用它，运行前核对 `--help`）：
465	
466	```bash
467	python "$HANDDRAW_SKILL_DIR/scripts/handdraw_video.py" doctor "$HANDDRAW_JOB_DIR"
468	python "$HANDDRAW_SKILL_DIR/scripts/handdraw_video.py" verify "$HANDDRAW_JOB_DIR" --assets-only
469	python "$HANDDRAW_SKILL_DIR/scripts/handdraw_video.py" render "$HANDDRAW_JOB_DIR" --preview --start 0 --duration 15
470	```
471	
472	两个变量由本机配置/任务提供；预览区间选真实代表段，15秒不是固定门槛。新画风、新声音、引擎变更或高风险动作先看代表段，再全片 render、verify；已验证路线的局部修订可直接核验受影响段和最终输出。`--preview` 是引擎的局部渲染，不要求生成网页或用户预览。直接使用 render 生成的 MP4；不调用额外的审核批准或 finalize 来获得交付资格。若该版本的 render 仍依赖这类门槛，检查独立制作模块或改用可直接制作的能力，不伪造通过字段。
473	
474	`doctor` 的离线合成 ready 与语音服务 available 分开：已有准确 WAV 时不需要再次生成旁白。缺声音时不能删音轨门槛。旧版字幕边界、音效开关或片头约束可能需要有证据的运行副本补丁；先核对是否仍存在，保留补丁，不重放历史任务专用脚本。
475	
476	最终验证：
477	
478	- 从最终 MP4 全解码检查规格、时长、字体、时序与源指纹。
479	- 查看每个完成页与代表动作连续帧，检查描线/填色顺序、笔尖归属、裁边和长词/数字。
480	- 连续播放并记录实际范围；静音播放只证明视觉路径。
481	- 解码最终音轨，核对源段→混音→有损输出对应、末句、切边、削波、响度与音画长度；AAC 不要求与 WAV 字节一致。
482	- 变更后检查实际新输出。默认交付当前视频；引擎契约要求的来源及可编辑源留作内部恢复，不因引擎生成而自动交付。完整作品按项目要求输出分别构图的封面。额外字幕、稿件或工程包仅按需提供。
483	
484	引擎的审核或交付回执不属于制作输入，也不代表作者确认或公开发布。

490	
491	# 多平台发布
492	
493	直接使用作品实际文件和用户指令；项目另有明确约束时遵循当前指令，本 Skill 不自行增加文档流程。确认作品版本、平台、账号、投稿类型、时间与时区，以及本次是存草稿、上传还是最终发布。复用已明确的授权；仅澄清影响结果的缺失项，不要求审核包、批准命令、哈希清单、发布台账或生产状态。
494	
495	## 执行
496	
497	1. **确认素材。** 打开实际成品，核对标题/正文/用户标签、适用封面、声明及排期。同一作品共用工程；平台需要的文件变体留在作品内。
498	2. **恢复会话。** 复用已有可控会话并现场核对账号。需要 Windows UI 时读 [界面操作](references/native-ui.md)。缺登录或验证码才请用户完成；不导出凭证、不接管日常浏览器配置。曾提交或结果不明时先查后台，用作品标题、封面、时长和时间匹配，避免重复。
499	3. **上传填写。** 等待上传/处理完成，填写完整文案；核对话题是否成为平台实体。分别保存封面槽位，检查 AI/原创声明、可见性、同步分发和完整日期时间。
500	4. **回读并提交。** 从当前界面回读素材、账号、文案、封面、声明和排期。日期操作可能改变通知选项。按本次授权执行最终按钮一次；只上传/存草稿不得发布。超时或跳转不明先查后台。
501	5. **查结果。** 在内容管理匹配作品，必要时展开折叠记录或清除筛选。直接告诉用户已上传、审核中、定时已保存、后台已发布或公开可见，以及实际链接/待办。审核中和保存定时可同时成立；没有链接就说明未知。一个平台的成功不证明其他平台成功。
502	
503	按需留存帮助恢复的截图或原始错误到作品内，排除二维码、地址栏令牌及无关个人信息；不为每个动作填写台账。平台自身登录、审核和验证要求以现场为准。缺 API 不等于不能使用已授权 UI；若主张协议限制，核对官方原文、读取时间与适用范围。

515	# B站
516	
517	核对账号、投稿分区、标题、简介、封面、标签与声明。标签通常填写为平台标签实体而非正文中的 `#` 文本，保留用户指定词义，不机械复制其他平台的正文格式。

519	封面按当前槽位分别保存；案例有4:3与16:9两种展示，需要检查裁剪。AI/来源声明与可见性按实际稿件设置。上传完成、转码完成和审核通过是不同状态，未显示错误不能证明全部完成。
520	
521	定时投稿后到稿件管理匹配标题、封面与时间。相邻卡片的日期可能靠得很近，必须确认时间所属稿件。必要时只读打开该稿件编辑页复核排期，退出而不二次提交。公开链接不可得时保持未知。

523	# 抖音
524	
525	先核对创作者账号及当前投稿版本，完整等待上传/转码。保留段落、用户指定话题，并从平台候选中确认话题实体，不能只有字符串 `#标签`。
526	
527	封面槽位分别操作；案例出现4:3横封面与3:4竖封面，以当前要求为准。每个槽位保存后回到表单回读。若组合保存卡住，保留文案和已上传视频，仅重新处理有问题的封面；案例中曾改用 JPEG 后成功，但不能据此把 PNG 当作确定根因或永久禁用。
528	
529	按实际内容选择 AI/原创声明。自动化 Select 返回成功后仍可能没选中，必须读当前状态；默认同步分发按本次目标核对。原生定时的日期、小时、分钟分别回读。
530	
531	最终发布一次后进入内容管理，按标题/封面/时间匹配。置顶旧稿可能排在第一条，不能取列表首条当新稿。后台“审核中”可与保存定时并存；上传4K不代表平台播放端已提供4K。结果不明先查当前内容管理，不刷新未保存表单重传。
532	=================== skills/multi-platform-publish/references/native-ui.md (1941)
533	# 原生界面与文件对话框
534	
535	优先使用当前环境已有的浏览器/桌面控制工具。浏览器打开不等于接通控制；核对当前窗口、进程、前台状态和目标文档。控件树缺文档时只诊断当前目标，不转储全部浏览器窗口或地址栏。
536	
537	句柄、PID、屏幕坐标、端口和 Windows 用户目录都在运行时发现，不写入通用脚本。依据文本、角色、所属容器及现场边界定位；同名按钮必须消歧，点击后重新读状态。网页重绘后重新取控件，不能复用旧引用。只读等待可以有限重试；最终提交不自动重试。
538

# 图文与封面

按作品写可编辑 HTML、文案和必要素材，直接导出图片：

```bash
node tools/cards/scripts/render.mjs workspace/作品/source/cards.html workspace/作品/output/cards
node tools/cards/scripts/render.mjs workspace/作品/source/covers.html workspace/作品/output/covers
```

每个 `section.poster` 是一张图片，尺寸由 CSS 明确指定，默认依次命名 `01.png`、`02.png`。可改 `--selector` 选择元素；`--width` / `--height` 只设浏览器视口，输出仍是元素实际尺寸。工具等待字体和图片就绪，检查根元素、子元素及各行文字的实际排版边界；文字既不能越过整张卡片，也不能被祖先容器裁切。`overflow:visible` 只在文字仍完整显示于卡片内时允许。工具阻止联网资源，失败保留定位信息。使用实际本地授权素材。

按 [项目封面规格](../../AGENTS.md#制作)创建独立元素，以下是可直接使用的尺寸示例：

```html
<section class="poster" data-output="cover-4x3" style="width:1440px;height:1080px">…</section>
<section class="poster" data-output="cover-3x4" style="width:1080px;height:1440px">…</section>
<section class="poster" data-output="cover-9x16" style="width:1080px;height:1920px">…</section>
```

共享标题、主体和设计元素，分别重排位置、换行与安全边距；不要对一个已完成布局做拉伸或机械裁切。装饰元素有意出界时仅对该元素标 `data-allow-overflow`；该标记豁免装饰几何边界，不能关闭内容文字的边界检查。

输出目录必须不存在；工具先导出到独占临时目录，整组成功才落定。不生成预览网页、联系表、审核文件、清单、发布包或台账。修订保留旧 HTML/成品，用新输出目录。只需要局部图片时用 `--selector` 选择受影响页面。

`validate.mjs` 仅在需要上游社交卡片专有检查时调用，依赖 `skills/guizang-social-card-skill`；并非普通导出的前置步骤。旧的 xhs 状态/审批/指标 CLI 已退役。
# Canvas 视频

共享渲染器从独立专题移至此处，原工程不复制。输入目录提供 `index.html`、`window.READY`、`window.END`、可选 `window.FPS` 和可按时间定位的 `window.seek(t)`；画布 id 为 `stage`。原生 `engine/` 默认取输入目录的上一级，也可用 `--engine` 指定。需要 `/shared/` 时显式传 `--assets`。

```bash
node tools/canvas/render.mjs workspace/作品/source --out workspace/作品/output/film.mp4
node tools/canvas/render.mjs workspace/作品/source --range 2 5 --out workspace/作品/output/change.mp4
node tools/canvas/render.mjs projects/shutter-within/film --engine projects/shutter-within/engine --range 0 1 --out workspace/样例/output/clip.mp4
```

沿用已有工程的画布与时间接口；原始 1920×1080 场景可通过 `--scale 2` 按其 `RENDER_SCALE` 实现输出 4K。默认输出在输入工程的上一级 `out/`，不会写进工具或其他作品。声音按需由视频 `compose.py` 或作品自身混音工具合成。逐帧流式送入 FFmpeg，不落全量帧。

现有 `--stills`、`--sheet`、`--motion` 可按需检查画面，`--review-dir` 指定这些可选样图的位置；不属于交付门槛。先测单任务再加 `--jobs`，失败只回收本调用的中间件，不覆盖旧输出。

原 `--inspect-revision` 调用保留：它读取该作品 `tools/inspect-revision.mjs` 导出的 `inspectRevision`，在已打开的影片页面执行并写入新的 `revision-checks.json`。具体坐标、时间段和判断属于作品源码；共享工具只负责加载、资源关闭和拒绝覆盖。普通渲染不要求这个可选模块。《快门之内》的实现见 [作品检查](../../projects/shutter-within/tools/inspect-revision.mjs)。

# 视频工具

从实际内容、声音和可编辑源开始。以下命令均在仓库根目录运行，输出已有时拒绝覆盖；没有状态、审核、批准或打包命令。

## Remotion

使用 `tools/video/package-lock.json` 锁定的 Remotion 4.0.534、React 和 Three.js；首次安装用 `npm ci --prefix tools/video --ignore-scripts`。浏览器复用 `tools/browser.mjs` 的当前配置，可用 `CREATOR_CHROMIUM_PATH` 指定。不要为旧作品自动升级依赖。

```bash
node tools/video/scripts/render.mjs workspace/作品/source/film.jsx workspace/作品/output/film.mp4 --props workspace/作品/source/props.json --assets workspace/作品/assets --composition Film
node tools/video/scripts/render.mjs workspace/作品/source/film.jsx workspace/作品/output/change.mp4 --composition Film --frames 120,179
node tools/video/scripts/render.mjs workspace/作品/source/covers.jsx workspace/作品/output/cover-4x3.png --composition Cover4x3 --still 0
```

入口直接使用原生 JSX/TSX、可选 props 与素材目录。画幅、帧率和时长由 Composition 决定；不强制 30fps、300 秒上限、静音或字幕。`--frames` 为包含两端的帧区间；`--still` 导出 PNG。默认单路渲染，实测资源后按需调 `--concurrency`。失败目录内保留定位信息，成功回收本调用的 bundle。

已有 `shotlist.yaml` 模板工程可选用 `python3 tools/video/scripts/prepare.py SHOTLIST NEW_PROJECT_DIR` 生成编辑源，再直接渲染；新源码无需这个格式。QEMU/PCB 专用模板保留自身的 1080p、30fps 限制。`qemu_sample.py`、`camera_fixture.py` 只生成可编辑示例内容；`sample.py` 是前者的便捷入口。

# 抖音网页发布

收到具体作品、账号和时间的指令后，按 [发布 Skill](../skills/multi-platform-publish/SKILL.md) 使用实际文件与文案。复用现有浏览器；需要 Windows UI 时按 [操作参考](douyin-windows-uia.md) 发现当前窗口和控件。页面条件以现场为准。

上传前打开准确成片，确认适用封面、完整标题/正文、用户标签、声明、可见性和时间。无需 state、审核包、清单、批准命令或发布台账。旧结果不明先查内容管理。

- 等待上传/转码完成，保留正文段落；从候选确认话题实体，不能只有 `#` 字符串。
- 封面槽位分别保存并回读。曾见 4:3 与 3:4 槽位；当前比例以界面为准。组合保存卡住时仅重做失败封面，不刷新整页或重传视频。曾改 JPEG 后成功只是案例，不是 PNG 根因结论。
- AI/原创声明、同步分发与可见性都从当前控件回读。UIA `Select()` 无报错也可能未选中；以实际状态为准。
- 日期、小时和分钟分别核对，再回读完整排期和时区。无授权不添加活动、音乐、位置、合集、共创或带货。
- Windows 文件对话框使用 `wslpath -w` 得到的实际路径。必要转存限本篇，核对一致后上传，不搬迁工程。

最终提交按授权执行一次。对话框中的“发布”与导航“作品发布”不同，点击前核对所属区域。超时、窗口消失或页面跳转不明先查后台，不重复点击。

内容管理按标题、封面、时长和时间匹配；置顶旧稿可能在第一条。必要时清除筛选或展开列表。审核中可与定时已保存并存；后台发布与公开链接分别报告。上传 4K 不证明播放端已提供 4K。不要求落盘表格，直接反馈实际结果与未知项。
# WSL2 图文上传与发布流程

适用范围：用户指定的单篇小红书图文或视频。Agent 与文件校验留在 WSL2，优先复用可用会话；必要时调用经审批的 Windows 浏览器与 UI Automation。本文整理 2026-10-10 的实际操作经验，不提供发布 API、无人值守发布器或跨平台框架。用户明确授权的官方网页/UI代操作可包含上传和最终提交；页面名称和控件以当次现场为准。

从作品实际文件和文案开始；制作入口见 [图文导出](../tools/cards/README.md)。不要求发布包、审核记录、批准命令或状态推进。

## 1. 续跑先确定本次允许做到哪一步

按需读取本次账号资料、实际成品与文案，并核对最新用户指令。已有提交结果不明时先查后台。

| 用户授权 | 可以推进的范围 | 停止位置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 仅制作或审核 | 文件制作、预览、校验 | 本地交付 |
| 上传与填写，不发布 | 指定账号的本篇上传、填表、声明设置和回读 | 编辑页；不点击最终发布 |
| 明确要求发布 | 本篇已确认版本的最终提交及结果核验 | 本篇结果确定；不扩展到其他笔记 |

明确授权且内容未变时不重复询问。后来的“只上传”会收窄范围；再后来的明确“发布”可以授权最终提交。曾经发布成功不构成下一篇的授权。账号、版本或稿件变更影响原授权时，先说明变化，再处理相应确认。

只补真正缺少的信息，例如本篇是否存在商业合作；已有回答直接复用。网络、登录和账号确认有记录时不重复整套诊断，但执行前仍须从当前目标窗口读到账号。

## 2. 将操作权限和技术能力分别核实

具体操作涉及协议限制疑问时，核对适用的官方原文。主张限制须说明协议名称、官方地址、版本或读取时间、具体条款及其与本次操作的关系，不要求另填诊断记录。没有发布 API、SDK 不适用，不能单独证明界面自动化被禁止；启动浏览器、工具可控或提交成功，也不能证明该方式得到平台许可。

已有原文限制确实适用且没有可核实例外时，停止受限的自动操作，可继续校验和交付供本人操作的材料；不以 Windows GUI、模拟点击、换工具或重复取得同一用户授权解决平台限制。原文无法取得则写“未核实”，不冒充已经确认。

本项目历史中的“仅本地生产/不做账号操作”是用户当时的项目内限制，已由后续明确授权撤回；这项变化不代表创作中心协议或其他平台条款发生变化。历史协议证据只用于定位待核实点，不能自动否定或自动许可本篇官方网页/UI操作。直接说明实际适用条件与结论，必要时保留帮助恢复的原始资料，不为每篇建立协议档案或循环搜索同一批 API、SDK。

# WSL 调用 Windows UI Automation

仅在没有更合适的现有浏览器控制会话时读取。这里记录 2026-10-13 已验证的原生交互方式，不封装平台发布接口。参数均来自当次发现；示例不是可直接重放的完整发布脚本。

## 目标窗口

通过现有工具或 UIA 枚举桌面顶层窗口，选择目标浏览器窗口并读到正确地址/账号。后续查询从该窗口的 Document 元素向下进行，避免扫描其他窗口和登录输入内容。进入文件选择弹层时查询范围是该窗口的原生对话框。

PowerShell 避免用 `$HOME`、`$PID` 等系统变量保存任务参数。例如，当调用方已经提供 `$targetHwnd`、`$targetPid` 后：

```powershell
Add-Type -AssemblyName UIAutomationClient
$target = [System.Windows.Automation.AutomationElement]::FromHandle([IntPtr]$targetHwnd)
if ($target.Current.ProcessId -ne $targetPid) { throw 'Target process changed' }
if ($target.Current.Name -notlike '*抖音*') { throw 'Target page changed' }
$document = $target.FindFirst(
    [System.Windows.Automation.TreeScope]::Descendants,
    [System.Windows.Automation.PropertyCondition]::new(
        [System.Windows.Automation.AutomationElement]::ControlTypeProperty,
        [System.Windows.Automation.ControlType]::Document))
if (-not $document) { throw 'Target document absent' }
```

标题含“抖音”只是窗口防误操作条件，不能替代地址与实际账号核验。动作前重新检查目标与控件，键鼠输入还需确认前台 HWND 一致及坐标在窗口范围内。前台断言失败应停止该动作；先恢复目标窗口再继续，不能把后续输入发到其他应用。

## 选择控件模式

先检查 `GetSupportedPatterns()` 或 `TryGetCurrentPattern`，再选操作。`FindFirst` 不能代替唯一性检查，最终提交和多项同名按钮尤其如此。

| 控件/任务 | 本次可用方式 | 回读 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 标题 Edit，名称“填写作品标题，为作品获得更多流量” | `ValuePattern.SetValue` | `ValuePattern.Current.Value` |
| 正文富文本 Group | `SetFocus`，目标窗口内 Unicode 原生输入 | `TextPattern.DocumentRange.GetText(-1)` |
| 普通 Button 或明确可 Invoke 的 Group | `InvokePattern.Invoke` | 弹层、编辑值或目标页面实际变化 |
| 同时发布/可见性等 CheckBox | `TogglePattern.Toggle` | `Current.ToggleState`；同时检查互斥项 |
| AI 声明 RadioButton | 先试 SelectionItem，失败后现场原生点击 | `Current.IsSelected` + 主表单声明 |
| 内容管理作品卡片 | 从唯一匹配标题找最近卡片祖先，`ScrollItemPattern.ScrollIntoView` | 只读取该条目中的时间与状态 |

富文本没有 `ValuePattern` 时不要强行调用。现场曾出现 class `zone-container editor-kit-container editor editor-comp-publish notranslate chrome window chrome88`，但 class 和内部浏览器版本后缀会变化；只能作为发现线索，不作为永久选择器。已保存封面入口的“选择封面”文字会消失，应重新定位封面 Group，不能继续依赖旧标签数量。

====

1. 发现当前浏览器/桌面工具与已有会话；现有会话可用就继续。旧工具句柄失效只证明该句柄不能续接，不能推断用户从未登录。
2. 现有工具不能控制时，再检查 WSL 调用宿主程序及已有 Windows UIA/浏览器连接能力。项目工作所需 PowerShell/UI 脚本可按每个进程 `RemoteSigned` 执行，用户已持续授权，无需就同项执行反复询问；仍遵守宿主审批、组策略和实际系统拒绝，不修改全系统执行策略、不用 `Bypass`，也不解除下载脚本签名限制。
3. 枚举顶层浏览器窗口和标签，读取目标页面地址、标题、实际账号及操作区域。只检查 `MainWindowHandle` 不能代表已检查全部窗口。
4. 将后续操作限定在已确认目标窗口。窗口句柄、坐标、控件位置每次重新发现，不复用历史常量；点击前核对目标，动作后等待实际界面状态变化并回读。
5. 当前页面确需用户登录时由本人完成。遇到验证码、访问拦截或限流，保留现场交由本人处理，不绕过。不要为切换到 Windows 而强制更换已可用会话。

“可控制”的证据必须来自目标后台：能读取实际账号和目标编辑区域，并能在授权范围内操作后回读。浏览器启动、本地测试页成功、仅看到 Chrome 窗口都不足以证明目标后台可控。

不得接管日常浏览器配置、导出或解密 Cookie、暴露调试端口、关闭全部浏览器或干扰其他窗口。原始工具错误应记录操作、时间、退出码和具体报错，不能统称“WSL2 不支持”。

## 4. 核对素材并顺序上传

打开实际图片或视频，核对顺序、画幅、封面与对应文案。上传需要的成品文件，不临时改稿或覆盖旧导出。

Windows 文件对话框使用实际可访问的 Windows 路径，例如 `\\wsl.localhost\<发行版>\<项目路径>\<上传目录>\01.png`；不要直接填 `[LOCAL_HOME]`。需要本地暂存时仅复制本篇文件，复制前后核对哈希，不搬迁整个项目。

在图文编辑入口按作品图片顺序选择全部图片，打开前回读文件列表，上传后等待完成。核对：

- 图片数量与本次作品一致；六图是本篇数量，不是平台固定要求。
- 第 01 张为封面，全部缩略图的版式顺序与实际图片顺序对应。
- 无重复、缺图或仍在上传的占位项。

顺序证据可以是有序文件选择加缩略图对应；如只核验了封面，不声称已逐张查看其余图片的大图。预览切换失败不能成为重复上传的理由。

## 5. 填写标题、正文和声明

标题逐字填写并回读。正文直接使用当前作品的文案，保留段落、空格、标点和话题；等待编辑器完成更新后再与源文案比较。不能因为调用返回成功就判定写入成功。

富文本编辑器的 `ValuePattern.SetValue` 可能压平换行；逐键输入可能触发话题补全而改变正文。需要粘贴时先确认编辑区焦点；使用系统剪贴板须事先完整备份可恢复的格式，完成后恢复，不记录原剪贴板内容。若不能可靠备份/恢复，暂停该方式并保留现场。

正文验收采用文本回读与截图互证：逐行比较非空文本，单独检查空段落；空格、标点、话题必须一致。UIA 省略空行与实际正文丢失换行是两种情况，不能简单删除全部空白后宣布一致，也不能只凭字数一致通过。

| 字段 | 操作与验收 |
| --- | --- |
| 商业关系 | 依据本篇已确认事实处理；未知不能自动填“无合作”。 |
| AI 内容声明 | 按实际创作方式选择平台提供的选项，回读选中结果；原创声明不能替代 AI 声明。 |
| 原创声明 | 用户要求且素材事实支持时，读取当次须知及确认弹窗，完成同意与“声明原创”，回读开关状态；不承诺平台一定授予原创保护标识。 |
| 合集 | 用户指定则按指定；只要求加入合集时，从现有合集选择与内容明确匹配的一项并告知，存在实质歧义再询问。新建合集需单独判断授权。 |

自定义开关的 UIA `IsOffscreen` 和坐标可能与视觉状态不一致。结合当前弹窗、标签、相邻控件、可用 Pattern 和截图确认归属后操作；不能无差别切换所有 CheckBox，也不能只因 `IsOffscreen` 为真就认定控件不存在。

## 6. 回读完成后按授权停留或提交一次

提交前在目标页面回读账号、作品、图片数量/顺序、标题正文、声明、合集及发布方式和时间，确认与用户指令和实际素材一致。现场核对即可，不要求保存整套截图、字段记录或审核文件；只有中断、错误或续跑确有需要时，才保留必要的恢复资料。

如果只获上传授权，停在编辑页并说明“已上传并填写，未提交审核”。没有实际保存及后台回读证据时，不称为“已保存草稿”；不要额外点击“暂存离开”。

已有最终发布授权且各条件满足后，确认准确的最终按钮，只提交一次，观察实际响应并从后台回读。点击后超时、空白、跳转或 `published=true` 都不是重复点击的依据。发生工具中断时按“提交结果未知”恢复，必要时保存提交时间与原始错误，先查后台。
